part5_ref: CA 5 — DCC Cannabis Unified License Search (the API behind it, resolved from the app's own config.js)

Carries premiseCounty, owner names, coordinates, licensing authority and the Adult-Use/Medicinal designation. Requires at least one search criterion, hence iterating the status list; the totals are summed and checked.

EACH SHEET HAS TWO TABS — one medical, one retail — and a CSV export without an explicit gid silently returns only the first, which would make Colorado look medical-only. Every tab is therefore declared with its gid. Lists update monthly except testing facilities, which update as certifications renew. med.colorado.gov sits behind a Cloudflare bot check, so the sheet links had to be read through the browser pane; docs.google.com is not a .gov host but these are the regulator's own published lists, linked from its own page.
